title: Commit a transaction from a call
summary: The agent collects, confirms, and then commits once through a single tool. The handler judges the confirmation against an allow-list of whole answers, and nothing reaches the order book before one.
scenario: A bicycle shop taking accessory orders by phone

evidence: demo goair voyager.py:216-272 code-enforced confirmation before commit
sdk function_result.py add_action('set_global_data') is the wire key; raw_data carries global_data and call_id
